name: Wikipedia: Horizon Robotics - Journey 5 / Journey 6 / Journey 7 product sections
notes: SECONDARY, citing Horizon's own launch material for the 25 April 2024 Journey 6 announcement. Journey 6P: 37 billion transistors, TSMC 7 nm, 18-core CPU at 410k DMIPS, 560 TOPS from 4 Nash BPU cores, LPDDR5x-8533 giving 204 GB/s, ISP with 24 channels for 4K / 18MP / mmWave / LiDAR; mass production expected Q3 2025. Lineup is 6B (entry ADAS, Bosch/Denso orders), 6E and 6M (highway NOA, SAIC/VW/BYD/Li Auto/GAC). Journey 5 was the first in the series optimised for Transformers rather than CNNs. Journey 7 announced March 2026 on a 'Riemann' BPU, J7P targeting >1000 TOPS to beat Nvidia Thor-X, arriving 2027. CRITICAL FRAMING: every one of these is an automotive SoC with LPDDR and a 204 GB/s ceiling - see the record's notes for why this is not a plausible LLM inference part.
